findings.title: The homepage has no canonical link
findings.detail: A canonical link tells search engines which URL is the main one when the same page is reachable at several.
findings.fix: Add <link rel="canonical" href="https://www.georgemridun.dev/"> to the page head.

findings.title: The site has no robots.txt file
findings.detail: robots.txt tells crawlers what they may visit and where the sitemap is.
findings.fix: Add a robots.txt at the site root that allows crawling and lists the sitemap URL.

evidence.note: not found, or not a text file

findings.title: No XML sitemap was found
findings.detail: A sitemap helps search engines find every page, including ones that are not well linked.
findings.fix: Generate an XML sitemap, serve it at /sitemap.xml, and reference it from robots.txt.

evidence.note: not found, or not a sitemap

findings.title: No organisation schema tells AI systems who runs this site
findings.detail: Organization or LocalBusiness markup gives AI systems a reliable source for the brand name, logo, location and profiles.
findings.fix: Add Organization (or LocalBusiness) JSON-LD with name, url, logo, sameAs links and contact details.

evidence.note: schema types found: Person, PostalAddress

findings.title: The page does not answer questions in a form AI systems can lift
findings.detail: AI answers are built from passages that directly answer a question. Question headings with a short answer underneath are the easiest to cite.
findings.fix: Add an FAQ or question-style H2 and H3 headings, each followed by a direct two-to-three sentence answer.

evidence.note: no question headings and no FAQPage schema

findings.title: The site has no llms.txt file
findings.detail: llms.txt is an emerging convention that gives AI agents a short guide to the site. Google Search ignores it, so this is a small bonus, not a requirement.
findings.fix: Add a /llms.txt with a one-paragraph summary of the business and links to its most important pages.
